column1: # The grammar this engine's committed answers come from. PartiQL has no
# server CI can start, so default is no image: it is the grammar of the
# PartiQL reference implementation, partiql-lang-kotlin, at the commit of
# the release in the source tag (partiql-parser/src/main/antlr). The digest
# is the SHA-256 of testdata/PartiQLParser.g4 followed by
# testdata/PartiQLTokens.g4, which are those files byte for byte.
# v0.14.9 is the last release of the grammar that holds every statement
# DynamoDB documents. The v1 grammar (v1.6.1 on 2026-11-13) was rewritten
# along SQL's EBNF and no longer derives INSERT INTO t VALUE {...}, an
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
